auth_code.title: SmartThings Find Login
auth_code.description:
Click [here]({login_url}) to sign in to your Samsung account.

After signing in, the browser is redirected to an **ms-app://…** URL (this shows a normal error page). Capture that URL:

1) Open Developer Tools (**F12**) → **Network** tab.
2) Enable **Preserve log**.
3) Sign in. In the request list, find the row starting with **ms-app** (usually red).
4) Right-click it → **Copy** → **Copy URL**.
5) Paste the full URL below.

💡 Tip: the README provides a small Console script that copies the URL automatically.
